papers.title: GenRec: Knowing Where to Reconstruct and Where to Generate
papers.authors: Ata Çelen, Jaewoo Jung, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong, Michael Niemeyer, Daniel Barath
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.intro: GenRec提出了一种基于观测掩码的生成-重建分解框架，通过多视角流匹配主干联合去噪RGB和场景坐标图，并配合像素空间重建分支恢复观测区域的高频细节，在观测区域实现最佳重建保真度的同时在未观测区域超越纯生成基线。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models for Analog Gauge Reading: An Empirical Study of Specialization, Transfer and Reliability
papers.authors: Abdul Mueez, Aaditya Baranwal, Junior Chaj-Mejia, Guneet Bhatia, Jason T. Voelker, Shruti Vyas
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Central Florida; Siemens Energy
papers.intro: 本文系统评估了Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型在模拟仪表读数任务上的零样本提示、上下文学习和QLoRA参数高效微调三种策略，发现QLoRA微调可实现低至2.39%-4.43%的归一化平均百分比误差，但跨域迁移和鲁棒性仍存在显著不足。

papers.title: Is Haar Enough? Exploring Symlets and Coiflets for Wavelet Convolution Layers
papers.authors: Md Rifat Ur Rahman
papers.tags: image classification, semantic segmentation, image generation
papers.affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了 wavelet 卷积层中小波基选择与分解深度之间的权衡（F-vs.-L 权衡），发现 Coiflet 基可以在更浅的分解深度下匹配 Haar 基在更深层次的精度，同时减少约 32% 的额外参数和 33% 的额外 FLOPs。

papers.title: Denoised Variance-Based Pruning with Optimal Brain Bias Compensation
papers.authors: Geon Tack Lee, Jaegul Choo, Kang Eun Jeon
papers.tags: vision transformer, edge deployment, image classification
papers.affiliations: DAVIAN Lab, KAIST AI; New York University Abu Dhabi
papers.intro: 本文提出DVBP + OB²C方法，利用随机矩阵理论（Marchenko-Pastur分布）对激活协方差矩阵进行谱去噪以获得稳健的神经元选择标准，并将均值偏移补偿整合进最优脑压缩（OBC）目标中，证明层间Hessian精确约化为激活协方差矩阵，从而实现无需训练的、最优的闭式权重更新，显著提升ViTs…

papers.title: MaLViL: Multi-axis Low-rank Vision-LSTM for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Afshin Bozorgpour, Sina Ghorbani Kolahi, Moein Heidari, Ilker Hacihaliloglu, Dorit Merhof
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: University of Regensburg, Independent Computer Science Researcher, University of British Columbia, Fraunhofer Institute for Digital Medicine MEVIS
papers.intro: MaLViL提出了一种多轴低秩Vision-LSTM网络，通过将ViL扩展到解码器各分辨率层级，在紧凑正交子空间上进行双向全局推理，同时通过跨方向混合器和统计引导的跳跃调制保留精细解剖细节，在多个医学图像分割基准上达到最先进性能并将ViL算子内存降低高达83倍。

papers.title: Leveraging existing sparse point annotations for benthic imagery dense segmentation
papers.authors: Cesar Borja, Breck A. McCollum, Jarret E. Byrnes, Kenneth Sebens, Ana C. Murillo
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Segment Anything, vision transformer, scene understanding
papers.intro: 本文提出一个新颖的框架，通过自动识别和过滤不合适的稀疏点标签（剪枝）并修剪传播掩码中的不一致区域（修剪），利用SAM2和DINOv3从历史底栖生物调查的稀疏点标注中生成高质量的伪地面真值掩码，从而训练更精确的细粒度语义分割模型。

papers.title: GroupForward: Building Referable 3D Scenes via Instance-Grouped Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Qijian Tian, Zimeng Wu, Xuhong Wang, Lizhuang Ma, Xin Tan
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, multimodal learning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（Qijian Tian, Lizhuang Ma）、北京航空航天大学（Zimeng Wu）、上海人工智能实验室（Xuhong Wang, Xin Tan）、华东师范大学（Xin Tan）
papers.intro: GroupForward提出了一种实例分组的前馈式3D高斯泼溅模型，通过低维实例嵌入将高斯分组为跨视角一致的3D实例，并在此基础上构建指代场景推理框架（RSRF），将语义3DGS从类别级语义查询扩展为复杂的自然语言指代推理和3D指代分割。

papers.title: SE-MoLoRA: Shared-Expert LoRA Adapters for Domain-Specific Photographic Assessment
papers.authors: Bishwash Khanal, Anlan Zhang, Sasu Tarkoma, Tommi Mikkonen, Abhishek Kumar
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Jyväskylä, Finland; Adobe Research, San Jose, CA, USA; University of Helsinki, Finland
papers.intro: SE-MoLoRA提出了一种共享专家-混合LoRA（Shared-Expert Mixture-of-LoRA）的参数高效模块化适配框架，通过一个始终激活的共享LoRA专家和三个按需路由的专业适配器（构图、光线、技术质量），将通用摄影知识与专业美学判断分离，实现领域特定的摄影批评生成。

papers.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Rodela Ghosh, Aviral Gupta, Guangjing Wang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image captioning, CLIP
papers.intro: 本文通过构建受控的图像-文本冲突数据集，系统研究了视觉语言模型在不同任务中如何根据模态退化程度重新分配对视觉和文本来源的依赖，发现模态依赖并非固定不变，而是随任务类型、证据结构和模型而变化。

papers.title: Mask What Matters: Saliency-Guided Video Self-Supervised Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Christopher Lang, Alexander Braun, Abhinav Valada
papers.tags: video segmentation, autonomous driving, BEV perception, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: Robert Bosch GmbH, Stuttgart, Germany; Robot Learning Lab, University of Freiburg, Freiburg, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出V-JEPA4A，一种面向自动驾驶的领域特化视频自监督学习模型，通过新颖的显著性引导掩码策略（基于Sobel梯度、光流幅度和运动补偿帧差分等信号）替代随机掩码，在保持V-JEPA架构和训练目标不变的前提下，仅修改掩码策略即可显著提升下游跟踪、分割和深度估计任务的性能。

papers.title: Rapid Debris-Volume Estimation from Post-Hurricane Aerial Imagery
papers.authors: Kooshan Amini, Jamie Ellen Padgett, Guha Balakrishnan
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, depth estimation, diffusion model
papers.intro: 本文提出DebrisHeightNet，一种基于分割条件化的单目碎片高度回归网络，利用冻结的视觉基础模型（Depth Anything V2和CLIPSeg-debris）从单次过境的灾后航空RGB影像中估计飓风碎片体积，并通过置信度加权LiDAR-单目融合（CW-LMF）合成训练目标，在十个跨五场…

papers.title: PROBE: Manipulation-Grounded Visual Question Answering with VLM Agents
papers.authors: Vineet Bhat, Siyi Chen, Alex Zook, Xuning Yang, Stan Birchfield, Valts Blukis, Jonathan Tremblay
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, autonomous driving, scene understanding
papers.intro: 论文提出了PROBE框架，包括高保真桌面模拟器PROBE-Sim、150个任务的评估基准PROBE-Bench和蒸馏微调方案PROBE-Agent，系统性地研究并提升了VLM智能体在需要物理操作才能回答问题的动态场景中的推理能力。

papers.title: OV3D-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Monocular 3D Detection
papers.authors: Mariia Gladkova, Neehar Peri, Ishan Khatri, Deva Ramanan, Daniel Cremers
papers.tags: object detection, 3D reconstruction, autonomous driving, BEV perception
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Munich, Carnegie Mellon University, StackAV
papers.intro: 本文提出OV3D-Bench诊断基准，用数据集级类别提示替代逐图像oracle，将检测精度解耦为几何定位、语义鲁棒性和跨域迁移三个维度，系统评估七个检测器后发现开放词汇语义是主要瓶颈而非几何定位，并提出一个简单的训练无关VLM重映射基线。

papers.title: CAS-FD: Contact-Aware Temporal Sampling for Single-View Foul vs Dive Recognition
papers.authors: Md. Jahidul Islam, Mahfujul Alam, Md. Nazmul Islam Seyam, Md. Tamim Hossain
papers.tags: video segmentation, object detection, YOLO, video generation, image generation
papers.affiliations: Premier University, Department of Computer Science, Chattogram, Bangladesh
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个基于YOLO驱动的接触感知时间采样和优先级加权空间裁剪的自动化单视角犯规/假摔识别流程，并发布了首个公开的600片段平衡数据集，在测试集上达到86.0%的准确率，比不考虑接触信息的基线方法高出12个百分点。

papers.title: The 10th AI City Challenge
papers.authors: Zheng Tang, Shuo Wang, David C. Anastasiu, Ming-Ching Chang, Anuj Sharma, Quan Kong, Munkhjargal Gochoo, Jun-Wei Hsieh, Tomasz Kornuta, Zhedong Zheng, Renran Tian, Judah Goldfeder, Fulgencio Navarro, Yuxing Wang, Yizhou Wang, Sameer Satish Pusegaonkar, Anqi Li, Nalin Dadhich, Ridham Kachhadiya, Dhanishtha Patil, Haoquan Liang, Jiajun Li, Han Zhang, Yilin Zhao, Zaid Pervaiz Bhat, Shuyu Yang, Ashutosh Kumar, Rong Wang, Rafael Martin Nieto, Peter Christiansen, Ahmed Abduljawad, Mohanrasu Shanmugam, Nadeem Shaik, Sujit Biswas, Xunlei Wu, Vidya Murali, Rama Chellappa
papers.tags: object detection, video generation, multimodal learning, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA, Santa Clara University, University at Albany SUNY, Iowa State University, Woven by Toyota, United Arab Emirates University, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, University of Macau, North Carolina State University, Columbia University, Milestone Systems, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: 本文总结了第10届AI City Challenge（ECCV 2026）的挑战设置、数据集、评估协议、排行榜结果和研讨会论文，涵盖六个主赛道和两个域外排行榜，展示了多相机3D感知、交通异常推理、文本检索、生成式预测和跨城市检测等任务的综合基准。

papers.title: PXDepth: Pixel-Space Modeling for Structure Preserving Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Yuan, Guanying Chen, Lingteng Qiu, Ruimao Zhang, Shuguang Cui, Xiaochun Cao
papers.tags: depth estimation, vision transformer, 3D reconstruction, edge deployment
papers.intro: PXDepth提出了一种判别式单目深度估计架构，通过将全局上下文建模与像素空间深度预测分离，在保持全局深度精度的同时恢复细粒度结构和锐利边界，且推理效率优于多步生成式方法。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Dengyang Jiang, Ruoyi Du, Zhennan Chen, Dongyang Liu, Zanyi Wang, Mingzhe Zheng, Xiangpeng Yang, Huanqia Cai, Aiming Hao, Yuming Jiang, Peng Gao, Harry Yang, Steven Hoi
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Nanjing University; University of California, San Diego
papers.intro: 本文通过大规模实证研究，提出了一种"潜空间预训练+像素空间后训练"（latent-to-pixel）的训练方案，系统探索了权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声调度等关键设计选择，使像素空间模型在保持竞争力的同时实现3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理加速。

papers.title: SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Yejun Zhang, Zihan Wang, Xu Ji, Yihao Wang, Yuxin Hou, Junyuan Fang, Juho-Matti Kilpeläinen, Arno Solin, Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli, Esa Rahtu, Juho Kannala
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Aalto University, Finland; Deep Render, UK; ELLIS Institute Finland; Nokia Technologies, Finland; Tampere University, Finland; University of Oulu, Finland
papers.intro: SplatGuide通过将单个3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建场景复用于三种互补的角色——渲染图像提供像素级几何条件、逐高斯源视图索引提供遮挡感知的参考视图选择、重建令牌提供特征级引导——从而弥合了前馈重建与多视角扩散之间的信息断连，实现了最先进的无位姿新视角合成。

papers.title: CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications
papers.authors: Yubo Zhang, Yiyao Liu
papers.tags: vision transformer, multimodal learning, image classification, CLIP
papers.intro: CM-MAE提出了一种基于物理引导的跨模态自监督预训练框架，通过波束轮廓引导的软对比对齐损失和掩码联合重建，实现视觉-无线表示在跨场景条件下的有效迁移。

papers.title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
papers.authors: Kin Ian Lo
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image retrieval, image generation
papers.intro: 本文在理想编码器框架下证明了双编码器绑定失败的三个条件性障碍——递归绑定的深度天花板、对比学习目标的激励节流、以及平滑性-绑定前沿——并通过对18个部署模型的测量表明，当前绑定失败并非维度或平滑性限制，而是激励和编码结构限制。
